# Backtest Engine Fixtures

The data in this directory is synthetic fixture-only test data.

It is not historical market data or live market data. It is not a production data source.
It must not be used for performance claims, investment research,
paper trading, live trading, or any financial conclusion.

The synthetic daily ETF bars contain no splits or dividends. The fixture exists
only to validate deterministic engine, accounting, artifact, and future ledger
integration behavior without network access or vendor dependencies.
